first_slice_probe.scope: Cold no-input first reveal: physical pattern plane3, including bits hidden by equal palette colors. First 182 rows and complete pass match SMS; selected native phase fields match V319. Full boot visual comparisons remain a separate gate.

observations: Source first-slice plane3 contains182 changed rows; V319 rounds this to180.
The row-tail prototype reproduces all2304 physical plane3 bytes at the first slice and completed pass in both regions, with selected native logic fields unchanged.
Physical VRAM-boundary equality alone does not prove source-visible raster equality: the isolated row-tail fix increases total visible errors slightly in both regions.
F1E calls F09/B95 before waiting for V112; charging its full IRQ again between copy slices is incorrect and seriously degrades NTSC.
Audio-only per-slice work without sub-instruction/row publication phase also fails the source-pixel gate. Do not promote any of these three candidates.
Next timing work needs continuous source instruction phase and visible-pattern publication timing, rather than another fixed frame or budget adjustment.
scope: Three isolated native experiments, every boot frame compared over14000 frames per region. Rejected development binaries, not numbered releases or gameplay changes.
